text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled migration window claimed by @anna for 02:00 UTC tomorrow. Lock token: migration-lock-17. Will start preflight checks at T-15m. :robot_face:
anna: thanks — confirming we'll pin service version to v3.4.1 before the DDL apply. Can dbeng confirm the migration script id?
mike: what's the expected concurrency impact? any chance we need to drop to read-only for a minute?
dbeng: script id `mig_2026_03_21_17` — it's an ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN + populate with streaming backfill. plan keeps live writes allowed but throttled. no full read-only expected.
priya: backfill will use chunked update loop. suggested throttle: 200 rows/s per worker, 4 workers initially. Command to adjust throttle is in ops-runbook:
```bash
# set backfill throttle
./backfillctl set-rate --job mig_2026_03_21_17 --rate 200
```
anna: copy. Also we'll pin the model-service and routing changes at 01:45 UTC to avoid schema drift.
mike: can we add a deploybot holdpoint after the DDL apply and before the fill completes? want manual verify on index health.
deploy-bot: Holdpoint created: holdpoint-dbpostapply-1765432101. To release run `/deploybot release holdpoint holdpoint-dbpostapply-1765432101` — note: requires 2 approvals.
sre-oncall: I'll be watching DB metrics. set alert for locks > 30s and replication lag > 60s. tagging: @sre-oncall.
dbeng: rollback plan: if locks persist or lag spikes > 120s, we will stop workers and rollback the column add by renaming new column and restoring old schema snapshot. full rollback steps in thread: mig_2026_03_21_17/rollback.md (ops-only).
priya: quick test snippet for graceful worker stop:
```python
# stop backfill workers without losing progress
backfillctl pause --job mig_2026_03_21_17 --graceful
```
anna: can everyone ACK the plan in this thread so we can lift the final gates?
mike: ACK. will be oncall during the window.
dbeng: ACK. will monitor locks and timelines.
sre-oncall: ACK. setting short alert thresholds and pager on for the window.
anna: thanks team. leaving the holdpoint release to post-apply manual verification. deploybot will post timestamps; callout if anything weird shows up. :thumbsup:
